_meta.description: Detective-themed word problems with a blank inside the story. Kid must reason about the whole scenario to find the missing number. Trains INVERSE thinking (the hardest part of subtraction/division word problems).

items.story: Sam had ___ marbles. He gave 8 away, and now he has 15 left. How many did he start with?
items.hint: Think: 15 + 8 gets you back to the start.

items.story: The birthday cake had ___ candles. 5 blew out and 12 are still lit. How many candles were there?
items.hint: Add the ones still lit to the ones blown out.

items.story: Grandma baked some cookies. After she gave 9 to us, ___ were left on the tray. She had baked 24. How many are on the tray?
items.hint: 24 total minus the 9 she gave away.

items.story: Maya bought stickers. She used ___ on her folder and had 18 left. She bought 30. How many did she use?
The store had ___ apples. After they sold 46 during the day, 24 were left. How many apples did they have that morning?
A pod of dolphins had ___ members. 7 swam away and 14 stayed. How many were in the pod?
items.hint: The two groups together give you the total.

items.story: Alex read ___ pages on Monday and 32 pages on Tuesday. That's 60 pages in two days. How many pages did he read on Monday?
The theater had ___ seats. 89 were filled and 34 were empty. How many seats total?
A truck had ___ boxes. 27 fell off during the trip and 45 arrived at the store. How many started the trip?
items.hint: Everything that was on the truck adds up.

items.story: There were ___ ducks in the pond. 4 flew away, and 9 stayed. How many ducks were there before any flew?
items.hint: The ones that flew plus the ones that stayed.

items.story: The Lego set had ___ pieces. Kai lost 18, but he still has 132 left. How many pieces came with the set?
Nia's piggy bank had ___ coins. She spent 24 at the fair and has 51 left. How many coins were in the bank?
A garden had ___ flowers. 6 wilted and 14 are still beautiful. How many flowers were there?
There were ___ kids in class today. 3 went home sick, and 22 stayed. How many were there originally?
The parking lot had ___ cars in the morning. 39 left during lunch and 52 remained. How many were there?
Kim had ___ marbles. She lost 12 and won 8, and now has 46. How many did she start with?
Aunt Rosa is ___ years old. Her son is 24, and she was 30 when he was born. How old is Aunt Rosa?
items.hint: Her age when he was born + his current age.

items.story: The team scored a total of 78 points. First half they scored ___ points. Second half they scored 45. How many did they score in the first half?
Tia found ___ shells at the beach. She gave 17 to her sister and kept 25 for her collection. How many did she find?
The rope was ___ meters long. After cutting off 14 meters, 27 meters were left. How long was the rope?
The gallery has ___ prints. 68 are landscapes and 47 are portraits. There are no other kinds. How many prints total?
items.hint: The two kinds together are all of them.

items.story: There were ___ kids at the birthday party. 5 arrived late, and 13 were already there. How many kids came in all?
The bracelet needs ___ beads. 12 are already strung and 8 more are needed. How many beads total?
A tank held ___ liters of water. 47 liters were used and 63 liters remained. How much water did the tank hold?
A jar has ___ ladybugs. Kim released 4 into the garden and 6 are still in the jar. How many did she start with?
A wall is ___ bricks tall. 23 are gray and 18 are red, with no others. How tall is the wall?
The road trip was ___ miles. They drove 137 miles before lunch and 96 miles after. How long was the trip?
There are ___ animals in the pen. If you take away 14 sheep, 22 goats remain. How many animals started there?
The playlist has ___ songs. Rae skipped 8 and listened to 27. How many songs are on the playlist?
The puzzle box says it has ___ pieces. Rin has connected 89 and 46 are still loose. How many pieces are in the puzzle?
